summary: Moody voted no in July 2025 on two resolutions that would have blocked proposed arms transfers to Israel and co-sponsored the Stand with Israel Act in May 2025 to cut U.S. funding to UN agencies restricting Israel's participation. Her campaign claims endorsement by the Republican Jewish Coalition. Her platform centers on America First foreign policy and national security without addressing Palestinian rights or U.S. military support to Israel.
